title: Sandpiper Cottage | Updated WaterColor Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Charming WaterColor cottage with 2025 updates, LSV golf cart, bikes, two king suites, pet friendly, and quick access to Camp WaterColor and pools.
description_expanded: Sandpiper Cottage Features - Whole home refresh completed in 2025! All new spa bathrooms, flooring, and updates throughout the home - Complimentary Use of a 6-seater LSV (golf cart). Some restrictions apply and must sign a waiver to use the cart during your stay - Access to 3 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape for your adventures - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, and non-aggressive breeds only. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - 1 min. bike ride to WaterColor Frog Pool and Sandhill Park - 3 min. bike ride to Camp WaterColor. Access to this incredible water park with lazy river, water slides, food and beverage service, towel service, and multiple pools is included with your reservation - Two King Suites on the 1st floor. Perfect if you are traveling with grandparents - Full Kitchen with stainless steel appliances including a Thermador refrigerator - Dining area with seating for 8 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 - Main living room with Smart TV and plenty of seating to enjoy movie night together - Back patio with pergola, outdoor dining for 6, umbrella for shade, and a propane grill - Screened-in back porch with cushioned seating - Front Porch with two cushioned bench swings - Driveway parking for 2 vehicles - Access to the WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and all community pool included with your reservation for 10 guests ages 5 and up - Community pools are heated during cooler months and provide towel service at the Beach Club and Camp WaterColor (subject to change by the neighborhood and no refunds are available if pools are not heated or towel service is discontinued) - Concierge services including grocery delivery, beach service, baby equipment rentals, and more available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to Sandpiper Cottage, nestled in the heart of WaterColor. The home boasts a quintessential coastal charm with its pastel-colored exterior walls and crisp white trim. A spacious front porch adorned with cushioned bench swings welcomes you to relax and soak in the serene surroundings. Parked nearby is a gleaming LSV (golf cart), ready for leisurely rides around the neighborhood. Upon entering, you're greeted by an airy and light-filled living area adorned with coastal-inspired decor. The open-concept layout seamlessly connects the living room, dining area, and kitchen, making it perfect for entertaining guests or spending quality time with loved ones. Plush sofas invite you to unwind while large windows offer glimpses of the lush greenery outside. One of the highlights of this home is its enchanting outdoor spaces. Multiple porches offer plenty of opportunities for al fresco dining, afternoon naps, or simply enjoying the gentle breeze and sunshine. A selection of bikes is available for exploring the neighborhood's scenic trails, while the nearby Frog Pool is just a minute away, offering a refreshing escape on warm summer days. In addition to the Frog pool, residents of this vibrant community have access to a wealth of amenities, including tennis courts, hiking trails, the Beach Club, and Camp WaterColor. Whether you're seeking adventure or relaxation, there's something for everyone in this idyllic coastal paradise. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Suite | TV, private screened-in porch, ensuite bath with walk-in shower and soaking tub
1st Floor Guest Room | TV, across from full guest bath with a walk-in shower
2nd Floor Bunk Suite | sleeps up to 5 in two Twin over Twin bunks plus a twin trundle, ensuite bath with combination shower/tub
2nd Floor Bonus | loft with Twin Daybed and Twin Trundle, TV

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night

all: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
